lessons.title: Mobile Accessibility: It’s a Different World 🌍
lessons.description: Understand how mobile context changes the game: touch, small screens, and situational disabilities.

lessons.title: Touch Targets & Spacing: Don’t Make Me Miss! 🎯
lessons.description: Master WCAG 2.5.5, target size best practices, and adequate spacing to prevent accidental activation.

lessons.title: Mobile Screen Readers: TalkBack & VoiceOver 🗣️
lessons.description: Navigate Android and iOS with gestures, understand mobile screen reader behaviour, and test your sites.

lessons.title: Responsive Design & Content Reflow 📐
lessons.description: Build layouts that adapt gracefully, support zoom, and never lose content or functionality on small screens.

lessons.title: Gestures, Touch Events & Mobile ARIA ⚡
lessons.description: Design touch interactions that are accessible, provide alternatives to complex gestures, and use mobile‑aware ARIA.
